contract: Linear signed integer precision1..32 bits. Store each channel sample in ceil(bits/8) whole bytes,left-justified with zero unused low bits. Uncompressed AIFC NONE retains this layout;sowt retains the existing FVid endian reversal.
implementation: Keep logical COMM precision in metadata;construct existing integer decoder at whole-byte stored width. Frame stride rounds per channel before multiplying by channel count. Reject nonzero unused low bits after stored-payload budget,storage-tail trimming and channel-frame alignment checks.
scope: AIFF/AIFC reader and actual FVid playback worker;no generic PCM API expansion,no full-format or external-decoder interoperability claim.
oracle: Generate mathematical signed integers and normalized f32 expectations independently of the Rust decoder;no FFmpeg invocation or decoder-derived golden samples.
